description: Validated-spec-to-visual renderers shared by backbrief tours, forebrief decision cards, inbrief, and the agent's own artifacts (kb/primitives/scope.md). ESM output ("type":"module", step 2 finding): tsc's default CommonJS emit put every `require("zod")` behind a boundary Rollup cannot tree-shake through, so a DOM-only consumer's bundle paid for the whole zod runtime regardless of how much of it a spec schema actually used -- see src/envelope.ts's header and tools/refresh-primitives.sh's neighbor, the bundle-budget test in forebrief's web package.
